message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "escalate_to_report_generator_on_negative_classifier_with_high_suspicion", "description": "When a chest X-ray classifier returns no strong findings despite high clinical suspicion of structural pathology, explicitly invoke the report generator to retrieve detailed morphological evidence.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving treatment planning or diagnostic confirmation where initial automated screening tools return negative or inconclusive results, but clinical context suggests significant underlying pathology requiring detailed visual analysis.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["treatment_planning"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` but clinical indicators suggest structural pathology (e.g., effusion, mass): (1) Do NOT accept the negative classification as final; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain detailed morphological descriptions and radiologist-style interpretations; (3) Use the generated report details to inform treatment planning decisions."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
